videos.title: USB-C all the things! #TITW
videos.description: USB-C all the things! The Werewolf VFLEX is a tiny programmable dongle that brings USB-C power to gadgets that rely on barrel jacks. I use it to make my desktop monitor portable, plug in my Super Famicom, and much more. It's not a buck converter: it uses USB-C protocols to ask your USB charger or battery for the right amount of power.
